boxes.text:
Select Wave A for the definition of the 32-harmonics of the first waveform. Click and drag the mouse to set harmonic levels.

Select Wave B for the definition of the 32-harmonics of the second waveform.

Select Modulate to see the morphing between the two waveforms. Morphing is controlled by the Morph CV input.

Offset and CV controls are used to set the base frequency of the oscillator.
## Provides access to global transport functions and remembers state and tempo with your patcher ##
## Produces a regular pulse signal synced to gloabl transport ##
## Source of uncertanty. Produces a random voltage with a trigger is received ##
This module is similar in operation to the Buchla 265 Source of Uncertainty or the Doepfer A-149-1.  It produces a quantized random voltage when a trigger is received.
